Store-level integration tests, including the acceptance scenarios:\n//! concurrent same-block uploads, orphan blocks, missing references,\n//! interrupted root switches, and GC/read concurrency protection.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse cas_repo::hash::Sha256;\nuse cas_repo::store::{DynStore, StoreError};\nuse cas_repo::vfs::{FaultMap, FaultyVfs, StdVfs, Vfs};\nuse common::TempDir;\n\nfn open_store(dir: &TempDir) -> Arc<DynStore> {\n    let vfs: Box<dyn Vfs> = Box::new(StdVfs::new());\n    DynStore::open_boxed(dir.path(), vfs).unwrap()\n}\n\nfn open_faulty(dir: &TempDir) -> (Arc<DynStore>, FaultMap) {\n    let faults = FaultMap::new();\n    let vfs: Box<dyn Vfs> = Box::new(FaultyVfs::new(Box::new(StdVfs::new()), faults.clone()));\n    let store = DynStore::open_boxed(dir.path(), vfs).unwrap();\n    (store, faults)\n}\n\nfn blob_path(dir: &TempDir, h: &Sha256) -> std::path::PathBuf {\n    let hex = h.to_hex();\n    dir.path()\n        .join(\"blocks\")\n        .join(&hex[..2])\n        .join(&hex[2..])\n}\n\n// ---------- basic semantics ----------\n\n#[test]\nfn put_get_roundtrip_and_dedup() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"roundtrip\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    let data = b\"hello content-addressed world\";\n    let out1 = store.put_block(data, None, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert!(!out1.deduplicated);\n    assert_eq!(out1.hash, Sha256::hash(data));\n\n    // Same content again: de-duplicated, blob not rewritten.\n    let out2 = store.put_block(data, None, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert!(out2.deduplicated);\n    assert_eq!(out1.hash, out2.hash);\n\n    let got = store.get_block(&out1.hash).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(got, data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn declared_hash_is_verified() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"hashcheck\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    let data = b\"some bytes\";\n    let wrong = Sha256::hash(b\"different bytes\");\n    let err = store.put_block(data, Some(wrong), &[]).unwrap_err();\n    match err {\n        StoreError::HashMismatch { declared, actual } => {\n            assert_eq!(declared, wrong.to_hex());\n            assert_eq!(actual, Sha256::hash(data).to_hex());\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"expected HashMismatch, got {other:?}\"),\n    }\n    // Nothing was stored.\n    assert!(!store.block_exists(&Sha256::hash(data)).unwrap());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_publish_and_occ() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"roots\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    let a = store.put_block(b\"version-a\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    let b = store.put_block(b\"version-b\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n\n    // Root target must exist.\n    let missing = Sha256::hash(b\"never uploaded\");\n    assert!(matches!(\n        store.put_root(\"main\", missing, None),\n        Err(StoreError::NotFound(_))\n    ));\n\n    let r1 = store.put_root(\"main\", a, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(r1.version, 1);\n    let r2 = store.put_root(\"main\", b, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(r2.version, 2);\n\n    // Optimistic concurrency: expected version must match.\n    assert!(matches!(\n        store.put_root(\"main\", a, Some(1)),\n        Err(StoreError::VersionConflict { .. })\n    ));\n    let r3 = store.put_root(\"main\", a, Some(2)).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(r3.version, 3);\n\n    let got = store.get_root(\"main\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(got.hash, a);\n    assert_eq!(got.version, 3);\n\n    let roots = store.list_roots().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(roots.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(roots[0].0, \"main\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn invalid_root_names_rejected() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"badnames\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n    let h = store.put_block(b\"x\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    for name in [\"../evil\", \".hidden\", \"a/b\", \"\", \"with space\"] {\n        assert!(matches!(\n            store.put_root(name, h, None),\n            Err(StoreError::InvalidRootName(_))\n        ));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------- GC: orphans, reachability, missing references ----------\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_removes_orphans_keeps_reachable() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-basic\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    // Tree: root -> manifest -> [leaf1, leaf2]; orphan stands alone.\n    let leaf1 = store.put_block(b\"leaf-1\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    let leaf2 = store.put_block(b\"leaf-2\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    let manifest = store\n        .put_block(b\"manifest\", None, &[leaf1, leaf2])\n        .unwrap()\n        .hash;\n    let orphan = store.put_block(b\"orphan-bytes\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n\n    store.put_root(\"main\", manifest, None).unwrap();\n\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.blocks_live, 3);\n    assert_eq!(report.blocks_removed, 1);\n    assert_eq!(report.removed, vec![orphan.to_hex()]);\n    assert!(report.missing_references.is_empty());\n\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&manifest).unwrap());\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&leaf1).unwrap());\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&leaf2).unwrap());\n    assert!(!store.block_exists(&orphan).unwrap());\n    assert!(!blob_path(&dir, &orphan).exists());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_reports_missing_references_without_deleting_parents() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-missing\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    // Manifest references a block that was never uploaded.\n    let ghost = Sha256::hash(b\"ghost-block\");\n    let leaf = store.put_block(b\"real-leaf\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    let manifest = store\n        .put_block(b\"manifest\", None, &[ghost, leaf])\n        .unwrap()\n        .hash;\n    store.put_root(\"main\", manifest, None).unwrap();\n\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.missing_references.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(report.missing_references[0].missing, ghost.to_hex());\n    assert_eq!(\n        report.missing_references[0].parent.as_deref(),\n        Some(manifest.to_hex().as_str())\n    );\n    // Reachable blocks are untouched.\n    assert_eq!(report.blocks_removed, 0);\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&manifest).unwrap());\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&leaf).unwrap());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_reports_missing_root_target() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-missing-root\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    let real = store.put_block(b\"real\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    store.put_root(\"ok\", real, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Forge a dangling root directly on disk (bypasses put_root's existence\n    // check) to simulate a root written against a since-lost block.\n    let ghost = Sha256::hash(b\"ghost-root-target\");\n    let root_file = dir.path().join(\"roots\").join(\"dangling.json\");\n    std::fs::write(\n        &root_file,\n        format!(\n            \"{{\\\"hash\\\":\\\"{}\\\",\\\"version\\\":1,\\\"updated_at_ms\\\":1}}\",\n            ghost.to_hex()\n        ),\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.missing_references.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(report.missing_references[0].parent, None);\n    assert_eq!(report.missing_references[0].missing, ghost.to_hex());\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&real).unwrap());\n}\n\n// ---------- GC concurrency protection ----------\n\n#[test]\nfn pinned_block_survives_gc() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-pin\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    // Orphan block, but a reader pins it before GC runs.\n    let orphan = store.put_block(b\"in-flight-read\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    let guard = store.pin_block(&orphan).unwrap().expect(\"block exists\");\n    assert!(store.is_pinned(&orphan));\n\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.blocks_removed, 0, \"pinned orphan must survive GC\");\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&orphan).unwrap());\n\n    drop(guard);\n    assert!(!store.is_pinned(&orphan));\n    let report2 = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report2.blocks_removed, 1, \"unpinned orphan is collected\");\n    assert!(!store.block_exists(&orphan).unwrap());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn get_during_gc_never_reads_deleted_block() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-read-race\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    // Reachable tree plus many orphans to give the sweeper work.\n    let leaf = store.put_block(b\"live-leaf\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    let manifest = store.put_block(b\"m\", None, &[leaf]).unwrap().hash;\n    store.put_root(\"main\", manifest, None).unwrap();\n    let mut orphans = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..50 {\n        let data = format!(\"orphan-{i}\");\n        orphans.push(store.put_block(data.as_bytes(), None, &[]).unwrap().hash);\n    }\n\n    // Readers hammer the live leaf while GC sweeps.\n    let stop = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));\n    let mut readers = Vec::new();\n    for _ in 0..4 {\n        let store = store.clone();\n        let stop = stop.clone();\n        readers.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            while !stop.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {\n                let data = store.get_block(&leaf).expect(\"live block readable\");\n                assert_eq!(data, b\"live-leaf\");\n            }\n        }));\n    }\n    for _ in 0..5 {\n        let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n        assert!(store.block_exists(&leaf).unwrap());\n        assert!(store.block_exists(&manifest).unwrap());\n        let _ = report;\n    }\n    stop.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n    for r in readers {\n        r.join().unwrap();\n    }\n    // All orphans collected eventually.\n    let final_report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(final_report.blocks_removed, 0);\n    for o in &orphans {\n        assert!(!store.block_exists(o).unwrap());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_switch_during_gc_is_serialized_and_safe() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-root-switch\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    let old_block = store.put_block(b\"old-root-target\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    store.put_root(\"main\", old_block, None).unwrap();\n    let new_block = store.put_block(b\"new-root-target\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n\n    // Run GC in a thread; concurrently switch the root. Because GC holds the\n    // roots write lock for mark+sweep, the switch happens strictly before or\n    // after the GC — never interleaved. Either way the *current* root target\n    // must survive.\n    let store2 = store.clone();\n    let gc_thread = thread::spawn(move || store2.gc().unwrap());\n    // Give GC a head start, then switch.\n    thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(5));\n    store.put_root(\"main\", new_block, None).unwrap();\n    let report = gc_thread.join().unwrap();\n\n    // The root now points at new_block and it must exist.\n    let rec = store.get_root(\"main\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(rec.hash, new_block);\n    assert!(\n        store.block_exists(&new_block).unwrap(),\n        \"block referenced by the active root must never be swept\"\n    );\n    // Old block may or may not have been collected depending on ordering —\n    // both are legal. What must hold: everything reachable NOW is present.\n    let reachable = store.block_exists(&old_block).unwrap();\n    let _ = (reachable, report);\n}\n\n// ---------- fault injection ----------\n\n#[test]\nfn interrupted_root_switch_keeps_old_root_and_orphans_new_block() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"fault-root\");\n    let (store, faults) = open_faulty(&dir);\n\n    let a = store.put_block(b\"root-v1\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    store.put_root(\"main\", a, None).unwrap();\n\n    let b = store.put_block(b\"root-v2\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n\n    // Simulate a crash exactly at the root publish rename.\n    faults.fail_once(\"rename_root\");\n    let err = store.put_root(\"main\", b, None).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Vfs(_)), \"got {err:?}\");\n\n    // Old root is still intact and readable — atomic publish means the\n    // pointer never half-moved.\n    let rec = store.get_root(\"main\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(rec.hash, a);\n    assert_eq!(rec.version, 1);\n\n    // The new block exists on disk but is unreachable: a classic orphan.\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&b).unwrap());\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.removed, vec![b.to_hex()]);\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&a).unwrap());\n    assert!(!store.block_exists(&b).unwrap());\n\n    // No leftover staging files.\n    let roots_dir = dir.path().join(\"roots\");\n    let leftovers: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&roots_dir)\n        .unwrap()\n        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())\n        .filter(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with('.'))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(leftovers.is_empty(), \"temp files cleaned: {leftovers:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn failed_block_write_leaves_no_blob() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"fault-block\");\n    let (store, faults) = open_faulty(&dir);\n\n    faults.fail_once(\"rename_block\");\n    let data = b\"doomed block\";\n    let err = store.put_block(data, None, &[]).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Vfs(_)));\n\n    let h = Sha256::hash(data);\n    assert!(!store.block_exists(&h).unwrap());\n    assert!(matches!(\n        store.get_block(&h),\n        Err(StoreError::NotFound(_))\n    ));\n\n    // Retry after the fault clears succeeds.\n    let out = store.put_block(data, None, &[]).unwrap();\n    assert!(!out.deduplicated);\n    assert_eq!(store.get_block(&h).unwrap(), data);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn corrupt_blob_detected_on_read_and_kept_by_gc() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"corrupt\");\n    let (store, faults) = open_faulty(&dir);\n\n    // Corrupt one byte during the temp write.\n    faults.arm(\n        \"rename_block_tmp\",\n        cas_repo::vfs::FaultAction::CorruptByte {\n            offset: 0,\n            xor: 0xff,\n        },\n        Some(1),\n    );\n    let data = b\"integrity matters\";\n    let out = store.put_block(data, None, &[]).unwrap();\n    // Note: the store hashed the *clean* bytes, so the on-disk blob now\n    // disagrees with its address — exactly what read-time verification catches.\n    let err = store.get_block(&out.hash).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Corrupt { .. }), \"got {err:?}\");\n\n    // GC marks reachable blocks and verifies them: reported corrupt, kept.\n    store.put_root(\"main\", out.hash, None).unwrap();\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.corrupt_blocks, vec![out.hash.to_hex()]);\n    assert_eq!(report.blocks_removed, 0);\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&out.hash).unwrap());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn io_failure_during_gc_aborts_without_deleting() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"fault-gc\");\n    let (store, faults) = open_faulty(&dir);\n\n    let live = store.put_block(b\"live\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    store.put_root(\"main\", live, None).unwrap();\n    let orphan = store.put_block(b\"orphan\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n\n    // Sweep's first delete fails: GC aborts, orphan stays, live stays.\n    faults.fail_once(\"remove_block\");\n    let err = store.gc().unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Vfs(_)));\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&live).unwrap());\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&orphan).unwrap());\n\n    // Clean run afterwards collects the orphan.\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.blocks_removed, 1);\n    assert!(store.block_exists(&live).unwrap());\n    assert!(!store.block_exists(&orphan).unwrap());\n}\n\n// ---------- concurrency: same-block uploads ----------\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_identical_uploads_dedup_to_one_blob() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"concurrent-upload\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    let data: Vec<u8> = (0..64 * 1024).map(|i| (i % 251) as u8).collect();\n    let expected = Sha256::hash(&data);\n\n    let threads = 16;\n    let mut handles = Vec::new();\n    let barrier = Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(threads));\n    for _ in 0..threads {\n        let store = store.clone();\n        let data = data.clone();\n        let barrier = barrier.clone();\n        handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            barrier.wait();\n            store.put_block(&data, None, &[]).unwrap()\n        }));\n    }\n    let outcomes: Vec<_> = handles.into_iter().map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).collect();\n\n    // Every upload agrees on the digest.\n    for o in &outcomes {\n        assert_eq!(o.hash, expected);\n    }\n    // Exactly one writer stored the blob; the rest deduplicated.\n    let fresh = outcomes.iter().filter(|o| !o.deduplicated).count();\n    assert_eq!(fresh, 1, \"exactly one non-dedup upload, got {fresh}\");\n\n    // One blob on disk, content intact.\n    assert!(blob_path(&dir, &expected).exists());\n    assert_eq!(store.get_block(&expected).unwrap(), data);\n\n    // No stray temp files in the shard.\n    let shard = dir.path().join(\"blocks\").join(&expected.to_hex()[..2]);\n    let stray: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&shard)\n        .unwrap()\n        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())\n        .filter(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with('.'))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(stray.is_empty());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_uploads_of_distinct_blocks_all_land() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"concurrent-distinct\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n    let threads = 8;\n    let per_thread = 10;\n    let barrier = Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(threads));\n    let mut handles = Vec::new();\n    for t in 0..threads {\n        let store = store.clone();\n        let barrier = barrier.clone();\n        handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            barrier.wait();\n            let mut hashes = Vec::new();\n            for i in 0..per_thread {\n                let data = format!(\"thread-{t}-block-{i}\");\n                let out = store.put_block(data.as_bytes(), None, &[]).unwrap();\n                assert!(!out.deduplicated);\n store.put_block(b\"in-flight-read\", None, &[]).unwrap().hash;\n    let guard = store.pin_block(&orphan).unwrap().expect(\"block exists\");\n    assert!(store.is_pinned(&orphan));\n\n    let report = assert!(!store.block_exists(&orphan).unwrap());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn get_during_gc_never_reads_deleted_block() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-read-race\");\n    let store = open_store(&dir);\n\n orphans.push(store.put_block(data.as_bytes(), None, &[]).unwrap().hash);\n    }\n\n    // Readers hammer the live leaf while GC sweeps.\n    let stop = assert!(!store.block_exists(o).unwrap());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_switch_during_gc_is_serialized_and_safe() {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"gc-root-switch\");\n    let store = End-to-end tests over real TCP sockets against the HTTP verification\n//! server.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse cas_repo::hash::Sha256;\nuse cas_repo::server::{Server, ServerConfig};\nuse cas_repo::store::DynStore;\nuse cas_repo::vfs::{StdVfs, Vfs};\nuse common::{b64_encode, TempDir};\n\nstruct TestServer {\n    addr: std::net::SocketAddr,\n    shutdown: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,\n    store: Arc<DynStore>,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server() -> (TestServer, TempDir) {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"http\");\n    let vfs: Box<dyn Vfs> = Box::new(StdVfs::new());\n    let store = DynStore::open_boxed(dir.path(), vfs).unwrap();\n    let server = Server::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\", store.clone()).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.local_addr().unwrap();\n    let shutdown = server.shutdown_handle();\n    thread::spawn(move || server.serve(ServerConfig::default()));\n    (\n        TestServer {\n            addr,\n            shutdown,\n            store,\n        },\n        dir,\n    )\n}\n\nimpl Drop for TestServer {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        self.shutdown\n            .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n    }\n}\n\nstruct HttpResponse {\n    status: u16,\n    headers: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn request(\n    addr: std::net::SocketAddr,\n    method: &str,\n    path: &str,\n    extra_headers: &[(&str, &str)],\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> HttpResponse {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let mut head = format!(\"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\n\", body.len());\n    for (k, v) in extra_headers {\n        head.push_str(&format!(\"{k}: {v}\\r\\n\"));\n    }\n    head.push_str(\"\\r\\n\");\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.write_all(body).unwrap();\n\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let split = raw\n        .windows(4)\n        .position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\")\n        .expect(\"headers\");\n    let header_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[..split]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header_text.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let status_line = lines.next().unwrap();\n    let status = status_line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap().parse().unwrap();\n    let mut headers = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            headers.insert(k.trim().to_ascii_lowercase(), v.trim().to_string());\n        }\n    }\n    let body_start = split + 4;\n    HttpResponse {\n        status,\n        headers,\n        body: raw[body_start..].to_vec(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn json_body(r: &HttpResponse) -> cas_repo::json::Json {\n    cas_repo::json::parse(std::str::from_utf8(&r.body).unwrap()).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn health_and_stats() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(json_body(&r).get(\"status\").and_then(|j| j.as_str()), Some(\"ok\"));\n\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(json_body(&r).get(\"blocks\").and_then(|j| j.as_u64()), Some(0));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn raw_upload_then_download_verifies_hash() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n    let data = b\"verification data\";\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")],\n        data,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let hash = json_body(&r)\n        .get(\"hash\")\n        .and_then(|j| j.as_str())\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    assert_eq!(\n        json_body(&r)\n            .get(\"deduplicated\")\n            .map(|j| matches!(j, cas_repo::json::Json::Bool(false))),\n        Some(true)\n    );\n\n    // Second upload of identical bytes is deduplicated.\n    let r2 = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")],\n        data,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r2.status, 200);\n    assert!(matches!(\n        json_body(&r2).get(\"deduplicated\"),\n        Some(cas_repo::json::Json::Bool(true))\n    ));\n\n    // Download raw bytes.\n    let r3 = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{hash}\"), &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r3.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r3.body, data);\n    assert_eq!(\n        r3.headers.get(\"x-content-sha256\").map(String::as_str),\n        Some(hash.as_str())\n    );\n\n    // Info endpoint.\n    let r4 = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{hash}/info\"), &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r4.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(\n        json_body(&r4)\n            .get(\"present\")\n            .map(|j| matches!(j, cas_repo::json::Json::Bool(true))),\n        Some(true)\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn json_upload_with_declared_hash_and_refs() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n\n    let leaf_data = b\"leaf over http\";\n    let leaf_hash = Sha256::hash(leaf_data).to_hex();\n\n    // Upload leaf via base64 JSON with declared hash.\n    let leaf_body = format!(\n        r#\"{{\"data_b64\":\"{}\",\"hash\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        b64_encode(leaf_data),\n        leaf_hash\n    );\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")],\n        leaf_body.as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    let manifest = b\"manifest over http\";\n    let m_body = format!(\n        r#\"{{\"data_b64\":\"{}\",\"refs\":[\"{}\"]}}\"#,\n        b64_encode(manifest),\n        leaf_hash\n    );\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")],\n        m_body.as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let m_hash = json_body(&r)\n        .get(\"hash\")\n        .and_then(|j| j.as_str())\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{m_hash}/info\"), &[], b\"\");\n    let refs = json_body(&r)\n        .get(\"refs\")\n        .and_then(|j| j.as_array())\n        .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(refs[0].as_str(), Some(leaf_hash.as_str()));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn rejected_hash_mismatch_over_http() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n    let body = format!(\n        r#\"{{\"data_b64\":\"{}\",\"hash\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        b64_encode(b\"actual content\"),\n        Sha256::hash(b\"declared different\").to_hex()\n    );\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")],\n        body.as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 422);\n    assert_eq!(\n        json_body(&r).get(\"error\").and_then(|j| j.as_str()),\n        Some(\"hash_mismatch\")\n    );\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn root_lifecycle_and_occ_over_http() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n\n    let a = Sha256::hash(b\"A\").to_hex();\n    let b = Sha256::hash(b\"B\").to_hex();\n    let upload = |s: &str| {\n        let body = format!(r#\"{{\"data_b64\":\"{}\"}}\"#, b64_encode(s.as_bytes()));\n        let r = request(\n            srv.addr,\n            \"POST\",\n            \"/blocks\",\n            &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")],\n            body.as_bytes(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    };\n    upload(\"A\");\n    upload(\"B\");\n\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/main\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")],\n        format!(r#\"{{\"hash\":\"{a}\"}}\"#).as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(\n        json_body(&r).get(\"version\").and_then(|j| j.as_u64),\n        Some(1)\n    );\n\n    // Stale If-Match -> 409.\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/main\",\n        &[\n            (\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\"),\n            (\"If-Match\", \"1\"),\n        ],\n        format!(r#\"{{\"hash\":\"{b}\"}}\"#).as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);\n\n    // Correct If-Match.\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/main\",\n        &[\n            (\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\"),\n            (\"If-Match\", \"1\"),\n        ],\n        format!(r#\"{{\"hash\":\"{a}\"}}\"#).as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", \"/roots\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let arr = json_body(&r).as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(arr.len(), 1);\n\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"DELETE\", \"/roots/main\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", \"/roots/main\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 404);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn gc_endpoint_collects_orphan_reports_missing() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n\n    // Live block under a root.\n    let live = b\"reachable\";\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")],\n        live,\n    );\n    let live_hash = json_body(&r)\n        .get(\"hash\")\n        .and_then(|j| j.as_str())\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/main\",\n        &[],\n        live_hash.as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // Orphan block.\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")],\n        b\"orphan over http\",\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    // Block referencing a ghost.\n    let ghost = Sha256::hash(b\"ghost\").to_hex();\n    let parent_body = format!(\n        r#\"{{\"data_b64\":\"{}\",\"refs\":[\"{ghost}\"]}}\"#,\n        b64_encode(b\"parent-with-ghost\")\n    );\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/blocks\",\n        &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")],\n        parent_body.as_bytes(),\n    );\n    // Parent itself is an orphan (no root), so it will be collected; nothing\n    // reachable references the ghost in this setup. Put it under a second\n    // root instead to observe a missing-reference report.\n    let parent_hash = json_body(&r)\n        .get(\"hash\")\n        .and_then(|j| j.as_str())\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/other\",\n        &[],\n        parent_hash.as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"POST\", \"/gc\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let rep = json_body(&r);\n    assert_eq!(rep.get(\"blocks_removed\").and_then(|j| j.as_u64()), Some(1));\n    assert_eq!(\n        rep.get(\"blocks_live\").and_then(|j| j.as_u64),\n        Some(2),\n        \"live root block + ghost-referencing parent\"\n    );\n    let missing = rep.get(\"missing_references\").and_then(|j| j.as_array()).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(missing.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(\n        missing[0].get(\"missing\").and_then(|j| j.as_str()),\n        Some(ghost.as_str())\n    );\n\n    // Live block still retrievable.\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{live_hash}\"), &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.body, live);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_http_uploads_same_block() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n    let data = vec![7u8; 128 * 1024];\n    let threads = 12;\n    let barrier = Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(threads));\n    let mut handles = Vec::new();\n    for _ in 0..threads {\n        let data = data.clone();\n        let barrier = barrier.clone();\n        let addr = srv.addr;\n        handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            barrier.wait();\n            request(\n                addr,\n                \"POST\",\n                \"/blocks\",\n                &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")],\n                &data,\n            )\n        }));\n    }\n    let results: Vec<_> = handles.into_iter().map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).collect();\n    for r in &results {\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    }\n    let hashes: Vec<String> = results\n        .iter()\n        .map(|r| {\n            json_body(r)\n                .get(\"hash\")\n                .and_then(|j| j.as_str())\n                .unwrap()\n                .to_string()\n        })\n        .collect();\n    let unique: std::collections::HashSet<_> = hashes.iter().collect();\n    assert_eq!(unique.len(), 1, \"all uploads address the same digest\");\n\n    let stats = srv.store.stats().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(stats.blocks, 1, \"exactly one blob on disk\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn unknown_route_404() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", \"/nope\", &[], std::time::Duration;\n\nuse cas_repo::hash::Sha256;\nuse cas_repo::server::{Server, ServerConfig};\nuse cas_repo::store::DynStore;\nuse cas_repo::vfs::{StdVfs, Vfs};\nuse common::{b64_encode, TempDir};\n\nstruct TestServer {\n    addr: std::net::SocketAddr,\n    shutdown: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,\n    store: Arc<DynStore>,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server() -> (TestServer, TempDir) {\n    let dir = TempDir::new(\"http\");\n    let vfs: Box<dyn Vfs> = Box::new(StdVfs::new());\n    let store = DynStore::open_boxed(dir.path(), vfs).unwrap();\n    let server = Server::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\", store.clone()).unwrap();\n    let addr = server.local_addr().unwrap();\n    let shutdown = server.shutdown_handle();\n    thread::spawn(move || server.serve(ServerConfig::default()));\n    (\n        TestServer {\n            addr,\n            shutdown,\n            store,\n        },\n        dir,\n    )\n}\n\nimpl Drop for TestServer {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        self.shutdown\n            .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);\n    }\n}\n\nstruct HttpResponse {\n    status: u16,\n    headers: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn request(\n    addr: std::net::SocketAddr,\n    method: &str,\n    path: &str,\n    extra_headers: &[(&str, &str)],\n    body: &[u8],\n) -> HttpResponse {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let mut head = format!(\"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\n\", body.len());\n    for (k, v) in extra_headers {\n        head.push_str(&format!(\"{k}: {v}\\r\\n\"));\n    }\n    head.push_str(\"\\r\\n\");\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.write_all(body).unwrap();\n\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let split = raw\n        .windows(4)\n        .position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\")\n        .expect(\"headers\");\n    let header_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[..split]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header_text.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let status_line = lines.next().unwrap();\n    let status = status_line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap().parse().unwrap();\n    let mut headers = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            headers.insert(k.trim().to_ascii_lowercase(), v.trim().to_string());\n        }\n    }\n    let body_start = split + 4;\n    HttpResponse {\n        status,\n        headers,\n        body: raw[body_start..].to_vec(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn json_body(r: &HttpResponse) -> Put it under a second\n    // root instead to observe a missing-reference report.\n    let parent_hash = json_body(&r)\n        .get(\"hash\")\n        .and_then(|j| j.as_str())\n        .unwrap()\n        .to_string();\n    let r = request(\n        srv.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/roots/other\",\n        &[],\n        parent_hash.as_bytes(),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"POST\", \"/gc\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let rep = json_body(&r);\n    assert_eq!(rep.get(\"blocks_removed\").and_then(|j| j.as_u64()), Some(1));\n    assert_eq!(\n        rep.get(\"blocks_live\").and_then(|j| j.as_u64),\n        Some(2),\n        \"live root block + ghost-referencing parent\"\n    );\n    let missing = rep.get(\"missing_references\").and_then(|j| j.as_array()).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(missing.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(\n        missing[0].get(\"missing\").and_then(|j| j.as_str()),\n        Some(ghost.as_str())\n    );\n\n    // Live block still retrievable.\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/blocks/{live_hash}\"), &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert_eq!(r.body, live);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn concurrent_http_uploads_same_block() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n    let data = vec![7u8; 128 * 1024];\n    let threads = 12;\n    let barrier = Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(threads));\n    let mut handles = Vec::new();\n    for _ in 0..threads {\n        let data = data.clone();\n        let barrier = barrier.clone();\n        let addr = srv.addr;\n        handles.push(thread::spawn(move || {\n            barrier.wait();\n            request(\n                addr,\n                \"POST\",\n                \"/blocks\",\n                &[(\"Content-Type\", \"application/octet-stream\")],\n                &data,\n            )\n        }));\n    }\n    let results: Vec<_> = handles.into_iter().map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).collect();\n    for r in &results {\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    }\n    let hashes: Vec<String> = results\n        .iter()\n        .map(|r| {\n            json_body(r)\n                .get(\"hash\")\n                .and_then(|j| j.as_str())\n                .unwrap()\n                .to_string()\n        })\n        .collect();\n    let unique: std::collections::HashSet<_> = hashes.iter().collect();\n    assert_eq!(unique.len(), 1, \"all uploads address the same digest\");\n\n    let stats = srv.store.stats().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(stats.blocks, 1, \"exactly one blob on disk\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn unknown_route_404() {\n    let (srv, _dir) = spawn_server();\n    let r = request(srv.addr, \"GET\", \"/nope\", &[], b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 404);\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"153b0834-2ba7-45aa-a806-a94ed487120b","session_id":"7cd997c3-1b91-495c-9d82-73da159982c0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a","sessionId":"7cd997c3-1b91-495c-9d82-73da159982c0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp5-a","slug":"sprightly-chasing-valley"}

Shared helpers for integration tests.\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\n\n/// Self-deleting temporary directory for one test.\npub struct TempDir(pub PathBuf);\n\nimpl TempDir {\n    pub fn new(tag: &str) -> Self {\n        static COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n        let n = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n            \"cas-repo-test-{}-{}-{n}\",\n            std::process::id(),\n            tag\n        ));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n        TempDir(dir)\n    }\n\n    pub fn path(&self) -> &std::path::Path {\n        &self.0\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Drop for TempDir {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);\n    }\n}\n\n/// Standard-alphabet base64 encoder (tests only).\npub fn b64_encode(data: &[u8]) -> String {\n    const T: &[u8; 64] = b\"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\";\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    for chunk in data.chunks(3) {\n        let b = [\n            chunk[0],\n            *chunk.get(1).unwrap_or(&0),\n            *chunk.get(2).unwrap_or(&0),\n        ];\n        let n = ((b[0] as u32) << 16) | ((b[1] as u32) << 8) | b[2] as u32;\n        out.push(T[(n >> 18) as usize & 63] as char);\n        out.push(T[(n >> 12) as usize & 63] as char);\n        out.push(if chunk.len() > 1 {\n            T[(n >> 6) as usize & 63] as char\n        } else {\n            '='\n        });\n        out.push(if chunk.len() > 2 {\n            T[n as usize & 63] as char\n        } else {\n            '='\n        });\n    }\n    out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":31,"oldLines":7,"newStart":31,"newLines":8,"lines":["     }"," }"," ","-/// Standard-alphabet base64 encoder (tests only).","+/// Standard-alphabet base64 encoder (tests only; One store object owns one data directory (single process). Internally:\n//! * `upload` serializes puts of the *same* staging paths;\n//! * a `RwLock` (`roots_lock`) separates **writers** from **GC**: `put_block`\n//!   and `put_root` hold it in read/write mode respectively, GC holds it in\n//!   write mode for the whole mark+sweep. = open_store(&dir);\n    let leftovers: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&roots_dir)\n        .unwrap()\n        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())\n        .filter(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with('.'))\n        .collect();\n    assert!(leftovers.is_empty(), \"temp files cleaned on open: {leftovers:?}\");\n\n    // Old root survived everything.\n    let rec = store.get_root(\"main\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(rec.hash, a);\n\n    // GC collects the orphaned v2 block.\n    let report = store.gc().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.removed, assert!(!store.block_exists(&b).unwrap());\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2b18baf4ed2d33bd67b4188e","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1200,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":113464,"output_tokens":1520,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_2te3fjwrhbjhm5wlc74attlv":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a/tests/store_tests.rs","new_string":"#[test]\nfn {"parentUuid":"51a7acbf-bf11-455f-8c8a-eedc6040d176","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_390e45ba179f41e08fc61af4","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a/scripts/demo.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# End-to-end demo of the cas-repo HTTP verification entry point.\n# Requires: bash, curl, sha256sum, xxd (only for the corruption demo), python3 (json pretty-print, optional).\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDR=\"${ADDR:-127.0.0.1:18080}\"\nDATA=\"${DATA:-/tmp/cas-demo-data}\"\nBIN=\"${BIN:-./target/release/cas-repo}\"\n\nsay() { printf '\\n\\033[1m== %s ==\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nsay \"0. start server (data dir: $DATA)\"\n\"$BIN\" serve --data \"$DATA\" --addr \"$ADDR\" &\nSERVER_PID=$!\ntrap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT\nsleep 0.7\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/health\"; echo\n\nsay \"1. upload two leaf blocks (raw bytes)\"\nLEAF1=\"hello from leaf one\"\nLEAF2=\"hello from leaf two\"\nH1=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF1\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\nH2=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF2\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF1\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; do wait \"$pid\"; done\necho; echo \"(all report the same hash; exactly one deduplicated=false)\"","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# End-to-end demo of the cas-repo HTTP verification entry point.\n# Requires: bash, curl, sha256sum, xxd (only for the corruption demo), python3 (json pretty-print, optional).\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDR=\"${ADDR:-127.0.0.1:18080}\"\nDATA=\"${DATA:-/tmp/cas-demo-data}\"\nBIN=\"${BIN:-./target/release/cas-repo}\"\n\nsay() { printf '\\n\\033[1m== %s ==\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nsay \"0. start server (data dir: $DATA)\"\n\"$BIN\" serve --data \"$DATA\" --addr \"$ADDR\" &\nSERVER_PID=$!\ntrap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT\nsleep 0.7\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/health\"; echo\n\nsay \"1. upload two leaf blocks (raw bytes)\"\nLEAF1=\"hello from leaf one\"\nLEAF2=\"hello from leaf two\"\nH1=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF1\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\nH2=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF2\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF1\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF2\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\necho \"expected leaf hashes: $H1 $H2\"\n\nsay \"2. re-upload leaf one -> deduplicated\"\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF1\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n\nsay \"3. upload a manifest referencing both leaves (json envelope)\"\nMANIFEST=\"manifest: [$H1, $H2]\"\nMANIFEST_B64=$(printf '%s' \"$MANIFEST\" | base64 -w0)\ncurl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$MANIFEST_B64\\\",\\\"refs\\\":[\\\"$H1\\\",\\\"$H2\\\"]}\" \\\n  \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\nMHASH=$(printf '%s' \"$MANIFEST\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\necho \"manifest hash: $MHASH\"\n\nsay \"4. block info shows the reference list\"\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/blocks/$MHASH/info\"; echo\n\nsay \"5. publish root 'main' -> manifest (atomic pointer)\"\ncurl -s -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d \"{\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$MHASH\\\"}\" \"http://$ADDR/roots/main\"; echo\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/roots\"; echo\n\nsay \"6. download a block back and verify bytes\"\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/blocks/$H1\"; echo\n\nsay \"7. hash mismatch is rejected (declared != actual)\"\ncurl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$(printf 'real bytes' | base64 -w0)\\\",\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$H1\\\"}\" \\\n  \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n\nsay \"8. create an orphan block, then run GC\"\nORPHAN=\"orphan payload $(date +%s%N)\"\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$ORPHAN\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\ncurl -s -X POST \"http://$ADDR/gc\"; echo\n\nsay \"9. missing reference: manifest pointing at a ghost block\"\nGHOST=$(printf 'never uploaded' | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\nPARENT=\"parent-with-dangling-ref\"\nPARENT_B64=$(printf '%s' \"$PARENT\" | base64 -w0)\ncurl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$PARENT_B64\\\",\\\"refs\\\":[\\\"$GHOST\\\"]}\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\nPHASH=$(printf '%s' \"$PARENT\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\ncurl -s -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d \"{\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$PHASH\\\"}\" \"http://$ADDR/roots/other\"; echo\ncurl -s -X POST \"http://$ADDR/gc\"; echo\necho \"(missing_references lists the ghost; the parent itself is kept)\"\n\nsay \"10. concurrent same-block upload (8 parallel clients)\"\nPAYLOAD=\"concurrent payload $(date +%s%N)\"\nfor i in $(seq 1 8); do\n  curl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$PAYLOAD\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\" &\ndone\nwait\necho; echo \"(all report the same hash; exactly one deduplicated=false)\"\n\nsay \"11. final stats\"\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/stats\"; echo\n\nsay \"12. on-disk layout\"\nfind \"$DATA\" -type f | sort\n\nkill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true\ntrap - EXIT\necho\necho \"demo done\"\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":70,"oldLines":10,"newStart":70,"newLines":13,"lines":[" "," say \"10. concurrent same-block upload (8 parallel clients)\""," PAYLOAD=\"concurrent payload $(date +%s%N)\"","+CURL_PIDS=()"," for i in $(seq 1 8); {"parentUuid":"2915fd75-aa35-417f-a4ed-23136b77d585","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_9fd0a39e02a3493d88c7fb90","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a/scripts/demo.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# End-to-end demo of the cas-repo HTTP verification entry point.\n# Requires: bash, curl, sha256sum, base64.\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDR=\"${ADDR:-127.0.0.1:18080}\"\nDATA=\"${DATA:-/tmp/cas-demo-data}\"\nBIN=\"${BIN:-./target/release/cas-repo}\"\nCURL=\"curl -s --max-time 10\"\n\nsay() { printf '\\n\\033[1m== %s ==\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nsay \"0. start server (data dir: $DATA)\"\n\"$BIN\" serve --data \"$DATA\" --addr \"$ADDR\" &\nSERVER_PID=$!\ntrap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT\nsleep 0.7\n$CURL \"http://$ADDR/health\"; echo\n\nsay \"1. upload two leaf blocks (raw bytes)\"\nLEAF1=\"hello from leaf one\"\nLEAF2=\"hello from leaf two\"\nH1=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF1\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\nH2=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF2\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\n$CURL -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF1\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n$CURL -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF2\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\necho \"expected leaf hashes: $H1 $H2\"\n\nsay \"2. re-upload leaf one -> deduplicated\"\n$CURL -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF1\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n\nsay \"3. upload a manifest referencing both leaves (json envelope)\"\nMANIFEST=\"manifest: [$H1, $H2]\"\nMANIFEST_B64=$(printf '%s' \"$MANIFEST\" | base64 -w0)\n$CURL -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$MANIFEST_B64\\\",\\\"refs\\\":[\\\"$H1\\\",\\\"$H2\\\"]}\" \\\n  \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\nMHASH=$(printf '%s' \"$MANIFEST\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\necho \"manifest hash: $MHASH\"\n\nsay \"4. block info shows the reference list\"\n$CURL \"http://$ADDR/blocks/$MHASH/info\"; echo\n\nsay \"5. publish root 'main' -> manifest (atomic pointer)\"\n$CURL -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d \"{\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$MHASH\\\"}\" \"http://$ADDR/roots/main\"; echo\n$CURL \"http://$ADDR/roots\"; echo\n\nsay \"6. download a block back and verify bytes\"\n$CURL \"http://$ADDR/blocks/$H1\"; echo\n\nsay \"7. hash mismatch is rejected (declared != actual)\"\n$CURL -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$(printf 'real bytes' | base64 -w0)\\\",\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$H1\\\"}\" \\\n  \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n\nsay \"8. create an orphan block, then run GC\"\nORPHAN=\"orphan payload $(date +%s%N)\"\n$CURL -X POST --data-binary \"$ORPHAN\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n$CURL -X POST \"http://$ADDR/gc\"; echo\n\nsay \"9. missing reference: manifest pointing at a ghost block\"\nGHOST=$(printf 'never uploaded' | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\nPARENT=\"parent-with-dangling-ref\"\nPARENT_B64=$(printf '%s' \"$PARENT\" | base64 -w0)\n$CURL -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$PARENT_B64\\\",\\\"refs\\\":[\\\"$GHOST\\\"]}\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\nPHASH=$(printf '%s' \"$PARENT\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\n$CURL -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d \"{\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$PHASH\\\"}\" \"http://$ADDR/roots/other\"; echo\n$CURL -X POST \"http://$ADDR/gc\"; echo\necho \"(missing_references lists the ghost; the parent itself is kept)\"\n\nsay \"10. concurrent same-block upload (8 parallel clients)\"\nPAYLOAD=\"concurrent payload $(date +%s%N)\"\nCURL_PIDS=()\nfor i in $(seq 1 8); do\n  $CURL -X POST --data-binary \"$PAYLOAD\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\" &\n  CURL_PIDS+=($!)\ndone\n# Wait only for the curls — a bare `wait` would also wait for the server.\nfor pid in \"${CURL_PIDS[@]}\"; do wait \"$pid\"; done\necho; echo \"(all report the same hash; exactly one deduplicated=false)\"\n\nsay \"11. final stats\"\n$CURL \"http://$ADDR/stats\"; echo\n\nsay \"12. on-disk layout\"\nfind \"$DATA\" -type f | sort\n\nkill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true\ntrap - EXIT\necho\necho \"demo done\"\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c94c4d35cb33d57dee26ab06","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1753,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":122880,"output_tokens":1341,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_9fd0a39e02a3493d88c7fb90":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# End-to-end demo of the cas-repo HTTP verification entry point.\n# Requires: bash, curl, sha256sum, base64.\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDR=\"${ADDR:-127.0.0.1:18080}\"\nDATA=\"${DATA:-/tmp/cas-demo-data}\"\nBIN=\"${BIN:-./target/release/cas-repo}\"\nCURL=\"curl -s --max-time 10\"\n\nsay() { printf '\\n\\033[1m== %s ==\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; echo \"(all report the same hash; exactly one deduplicated=false)\""," "," say \"11. final stats\"","-curl -s \"http://$ADDR/stats\"; echo","+$CURL \"http://$ADDR/stats\"; echo"," "," say \"12. on-disk layout\""," find \"$DATA\" -type f | sort"]}],"originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# End-to-end demo of the cas-repo HTTP verification entry point.\n# Requires: bash, curl, sha256sum, xxd (only for the corruption demo), python3 (json pretty-print, optional).\nset -euo pipefail\n\nADDR=\"${ADDR:-127.0.0.1:18080}\"\nDATA=\"${DATA:-/tmp/cas-demo-data}\"\nBIN=\"${BIN:-./target/release/cas-repo}\"\n\nsay() { printf '\\n\\033[1m== %s ==\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nsay \"0. start server (data dir: $DATA)\"\n\"$BIN\" serve --data \"$DATA\" --addr \"$ADDR\" &\nSERVER_PID=$!\ntrap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT\nsleep 0.7\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/health\"; echo\n\nsay \"1. upload two leaf blocks (raw bytes)\"\nLEAF1=\"hello from leaf one\"\nLEAF2=\"hello from leaf two\"\nH1=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF1\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\nH2=$(printf '%s' \"$LEAF2\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF1\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF2\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\necho \"expected leaf hashes: $H1 $H2\"\n\nsay \"2. re-upload leaf one -> deduplicated\"\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$LEAF1\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n\nsay \"3. upload a manifest referencing both leaves (json envelope)\"\nMANIFEST=\"manifest: [$H1, $H2]\"\nMANIFEST_B64=$(printf '%s' \"$MANIFEST\" | base64 -w0)\ncurl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$MANIFEST_B64\\\",\\\"refs\\\":[\\\"$H1\\\",\\\"$H2\\\"]}\" \\\n  \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\nMHASH=$(printf '%s' \"$MANIFEST\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\necho \"manifest hash: $MHASH\"\n\nsay \"4. block info shows the reference list\"\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/blocks/$MHASH/info\"; echo\n\nsay \"5. publish root 'main' -> manifest (atomic pointer)\"\ncurl -s -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d \"{\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$MHASH\\\"}\" \"http://$ADDR/roots/main\"; echo\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/roots\"; echo\n\nsay \"6. download a block back and verify bytes\"\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/blocks/$H1\"; echo\n\nsay \"7. hash mismatch is rejected (declared != actual)\"\ncurl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$(printf 'real bytes' | base64 -w0)\\\",\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$H1\\\"}\" \\\n  \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\n\nsay \"8. create an orphan block, then run GC\"\nORPHAN=\"orphan payload $(date +%s%N)\"\ncurl -s -X POST --data-binary \"$ORPHAN\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\ncurl -s -X POST \"http://$ADDR/gc\"; echo\n\nsay \"9. missing reference: manifest pointing at a ghost block\"\nGHOST=$(printf 'never uploaded' | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\nPARENT=\"parent-with-dangling-ref\"\nPARENT_B64=$(printf '%s' \"$PARENT\" | base64 -w0)\ncurl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"$PARENT_B64\\\",\\\"refs\\\":[\\\"$GHOST\\\"]}\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\"; echo\nPHASH=$(printf '%s' \"$PARENT\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)\ncurl -s -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d \"{\\\"hash\\\":\\\"$PHASH\\\"}\" \"http://$ADDR/roots/other\"; echo\ncurl -s -X POST \"http://$ADDR/gc\"; echo\necho \"(missing_references lists the ghost; the parent itself is kept)\"\n\nsay \"10. concurrent same-block upload (8 parallel clients)\"\nPAYLOAD=\"concurrent payload $(date +%s%N)\"\nCURL_PIDS=()\nfor i in $(seq 1 8); do\n  curl -s --max-time 10 -X POST --data-binary \"$PAYLOAD\" \"http://$ADDR/blocks\" &\n  CURL_PIDS+=($!)\ndone\n# Wait only for the curls — a bare `wait` would also wait for the server.\nfor pid in \"${CURL_PIDS[@]}\"; do wait \"$pid\"; done\necho; echo \"(all report the same hash; exactly one deduplicated=false)\"\n\nsay \"11. final stats\"\ncurl -s \"http://$ADDR/stats\"; echo\n\nsay \"12. on-disk layout\"\nfind \"$DATA\" -type f | sort\n\nkill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true\ntrap - EXIT\necho\necho \"demo done\"\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"afe8c3aa-c41c-4978-b316-c8712eaf8c5b","session_id":"7cd997c3-1b91-495c-9d82-73da159982c0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a","sessionId":"7cd997c3-1b91-495c-9d82-73da159982c0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp5-a","slug":"sprightly-chasing-valley"}

{"parentUuid":"e2a64dff-f6f3-4160-a075-7720a7116a5d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_6cx2w3vwnrge44nvju28mogc","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a/README.md","content":"# cas-repo — 内容寻址块仓库（纯后端）\n\n一个用 Rust 实现的、**文件支持（file-backed）**的内容寻址存储库，带一个本地\nHTTP 验证入口。块按其内容的 SHA-256 摘要寻址、不可变；支持具名根（named\nroots）、同内容去重、根更新原子发布、标记清扫（mark-sweep）垃圾回收，并在\n读取/标记时用哈希做**完整性校验**。\n\n整个项目**零第三方依赖**：SHA-256、JSON、HTTP/1.1 服务器全部手写，可离线\n构建与审计。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\n\n# 启动（数据目录会自动初始化）\n./target/release/cas-repo serve --data ./data --addr 127.0.0.1:8080\n```\n\n只支持一个子命令：\n\n```text\ncas-repo serve --data <DATA_DIR> [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080]\n```\n\n- `--data` / `-d`：仓库数据目录（必填）。\n- `--addr` / `-a`：监听地址（默认 `127.0.0.1:8080`）。\n\n进程对一个数据目录拥有单进程所有权（不支持两个进程同时打开同一目录）。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 磁盘格式（format version 1，明确且稳定）\n\n```text\n<data-dir>/\n  VERSION                          # 内容固定为 \"cas-repo v1\\n\"\n  blocks/\n    <aa>/                          # 摘要第 1 字节，256 个分片子目录\n      <rest-62hex>                 # 不可变块：字节即块内容\n      <rest-62hex>.refs.json       # 引用边车: {\"version\":1,\"refs\":[\"<sha256>\",...]}\n      .<name>.tmp-<rand>           # 原子发布的暂存文件\n  roots/\n    <name>.json                    # 根指针: {\"hash\",\"version\",\"updated_at_ms\"}\n    .<name>.json.tmp-<rand>        # 根原子发布的暂存文件\n```\n\n格式规则：\n\n- 块文件路径由其摘要决定：`blocks/<前2位十六进制>/<后62位十六进制>`。\n- **不变性**：块字节一旦发布永不重写。再次 `put` 同摘要只做去重，并把新\n  声明的引用与旧边车取并集。\n- **引用边车**是独立 JSON 文件，随块一起原子更新；允许引用尚未上传的块\n  （前向引用），因此 GC 能显式报告\"缺失引用\"。\n- **根指针**是 `roots/<name>.json`，含目标块摘要、单调递增的 `version`\n  和 `updated_at_ms`。根名规则：`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`、长度 1–128、不得以点开头\n  （防止路径穿越和与暂存文件冲突）。\n- 每次写入都走 **`写同目录暂存文件 → fsync → rename 原子替换 → fsync 目录`**。\n  崩溃后可能残留 `.tmp-*` 文件；它们在**下次打开仓库时**统一回收（此刻无\n  并发写者，因为是单进程所有权）。GC 运行期间**不**删除暂存文件，以免误删\n  正在进行的上传。\n\n### 哈希的定位（重要）\n\nSHA-256 摘要**仅用于完整性校验**：\n\n- 上传时对实际字节求摘要；若客户端在信封里给了 `hash`，必须与实算值一致，\n  否则返回 `422 hash_mismatch`，块不落盘。\n- 读取时重新对磁盘字节求摘要，与地址不符返回 `409 corrupt_block`。\n- GC 标记每个可达块时也校验摘要，损坏块进入 `corrupt_blocks` 报告并被保留。\n\n摘要**不是**访问凭证/能力令牌；本服务没有鉴权层，仅绑定回环地址做本地验证。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 同步边界（concurrency model）\n\n单进程、多线程。一个 `Store` 对象拥有一个数据目录，内部边界如下：\n\n| 机制 | 保护对象 |\n|------|----------|\n| `upload: Mutex<()>` | 串行化块/边车发布，避免同摘要并发写互相踩踏暂存文件 |\n| `roots_lock: RwLock<()>` | **写者与 GC 互斥**：`put_block` 取读锁，`put_root`/`delete_root` 与 GC 取写锁；根切换、上传与 mark-sweep 永不交叠 |\n| `PinTable`（引用计数） | 保护\"正在读取/正在上传/GC 已标记\"的块不被清扫 |\n\n- **读块不加 `roots_lock`**：`get_block` 先 pin → 读 → 校验 → 读完 unpin。\n- **清扫在 pin 表锁内执行 unlink**：并发读/上传要么其 pin 已可见（跳过删除），\n  要么在删除完成后才 pin（此时观察到 not found 并可重建）。因此**可达块不\n  可能被误删**。\n- **根更新原子发布**：一次 temp+fsync+rename，读者只可能看到旧版本或新版本，\n  不存在半个根。发布失败时旧指针完好，新块成为孤儿（下次 GC 回收）。\n- 乐观并发（OCC）：`PUT /roots/{name}` 可带 `If-Match: <version>`，当前版本\n  不符返回 `409 version_conflict`（不存在的根版本记为 0）。\n\n这套设计把\"引用在标记中途被加入\"\"根在清扫中途切换\"两个窗口，通过写者/GC\n互斥从根上关闭；把\"读到一半被删\"通过 pin 在锁内删除关闭。\n\n---\n\n## 4. HTTP API\n\n所有连接走真实 TCP（HTTP/1.1、keep-alive、thread-per-connection），仅用于\n验证，不是生产级 Web 服务器（无 TLS、无鉴权）。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|------|------|------|\n| GET  | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| POST | `/blocks` | 上传块（原始字节，或 JSON 信封） |\n| GET  | `/blocks/{hash}` | 取原始字节（响应头回带 `X-Content-Sha256`，并重新校验） |\n| GET  | `/blocks/{hash}/info` | 块是否存在 + 引用列表 |\n| PUT  | `/roots/{name}` | 原子发布/更新根；可选 `If-Match: version` |\n| GET  | `/roots` | 列出全部根 |\n| GET  | `/roots/{name}` | 读取单个根 |\n| DELETE | `/roots/{name}` | 删除根（块不动，变为待回收） |\n| POST | `/gc` | 执行 mark-sweep，返回报告 |\n| GET  | `/stats` | 根数量、块数量、块字节数 |\n\n### 上传格式\n\n**原始字节**（`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`）：body 即块内容。\n可用请求头 `X-Content-Sha256: <hex>` 声明期望摘要（不符则拒绝）。\n\n**JSON 信封**（`Content-Type: application/json`）：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"data_b64\": \"<标准 base64 编码的块字节>\",\n  \"hash\":     \"<可选，客户端期望的 sha256 hex>\",\n  \"refs\":     [\"<可选，被引用块的 sha256 hex>\", \"...\"]\n}\n```\n\n### 发布根\n\nbody 可以是 JSON `{\"hash\":\"<hex>\"}`，也可以直接放裸摘要字符串。\n目标块必须已存在，否则 `404 not_found`。\n\n### GC 报告\n\n```json\n{\n  \"roots_scanned\": 2,\n  \"blocks_before\": 4,\n  \"blocks_live\": 4,\n  \"blocks_removed\": 1,\n  \"bytes_removed\": 34,\n  \"removed\": [\"<hex>\", \"...\"],\n  \"missing_references\": [ { \"parent\": \"<hex 或 null>\", \"missing\": \"<hex>\" } ],\n  \"corrupt_blocks\": [\"<hex>\"],\n  \"warnings\": []\n}\n```\n\n- 从所有根出发沿 `refs` 做可达性遍历；只清扫**不可达且未被 pin** 的块。\n- `missing_references`：父块（`parent=null` 表示根目标本身缺失）引用了磁盘上\n  不存在的摘要。父块本身可达时**保留**，只报告。\n- `corrupt_blocks`：可达但字节与地址摘要不符。保留并报告，绝不静默删除。\n\n完整可复制的请求样例见 [`examples/requests.http`](examples/requests.http)\n和可直接运行的 [`scripts/demo.sh`](scripts/demo.sh)。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 可注入 I/O 层与故障模拟\n\n所有磁盘访问都经过 `vfs::Vfs` trait（`src/vfs.rs`）：\n\n- `StdVfs`：`std::fs` 的薄封装，真实服务器使用。\n- `FaultyVfs`：包一层，在具名**调用点（site）**上注入故障。故障规则可在\n  运行时装填（`FaultMap::arm / fail_once / clear`），跨线程共享。\n\n故障动作（`FaultAction`）：\n\n- `Fail`：该调用直接返回注入的 `io::Error`，什么都不做。\n- `CorruptByte { offset, xor }`：写暂存文件前把指定字节异或，制造磁盘损坏。\n- `SucceedThenFail`：操作实际成功但仍返回错误（\"写成功却报错\"）。\n\n关键注入点：`rename_root`（根发布 rename 前崩溃）、`rename_block`、\n`rename_block_tmp`、`remove_block`、`read_block`、`exists_block` 等。\n\n示例（Rust，见 `tests/store_tests.rs`）：\n\n```rust\nlet faults = FaultMap::new();\nlet vfs = FaultyVfs::new(Box::new(StdVfs::new()), faults.clone());\nlet store = DynStore::open_boxed(dir, Box::new(vfs))?;\n\nlet a = store.put_block(b\"v1\", None, &[])?.hash;\nstore.put_root(\"main\", a, None)?;\nlet b = store.put_block(b\"v2\", None, &[])?.hash;\n\nfaults.fail_once(\"rename_root\");           // 根发布 rename 时\"崩溃\"\nassert!(store.put_root(\"main\", b, None).is_err());\nassert_eq!(store.get_root(\"main\")?.hash, a);   // 旧根完好\nassert!(store.block_exists(&b)?);              // 新块成为孤儿\nlet report = store.gc()?;                      // 孤儿被回收，可达块不动\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. 自动化测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test              # 全部\ncargo test --release    # 优化构建下再跑一遍\ncargo clippy --all-targets\n```\n\n测试组成：\n\n- `src/hash.rs`：SHA-256 NIST 向量（含一百万个 cas-repo — 内容寻址块仓库（纯后端）\n\n一个用 Rust 实现的、**文件支持（file-backed）**的内容寻址存储库，带一个本地\nHTTP 验证入口。块按其内容的 SHA-256 摘要寻址、不可变；支持具名根（named\nroots）、同内容去重、根更新原子发布、标记清扫（mark-sweep）垃圾回收，并在\n读取/标记时用哈希做**完整性校验**。\n\n整个项目**零第三方依赖**：SHA-256、JSON、HTTP/1.1 服务器全部手写，可离线\n构建与审计。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\n\n# 启动（数据目录会自动初始化）\n./target/release/cas-repo serve --data ./data --addr 127.0.0.1:8080\n```\n\n只支持一个子命令：\n\n```text\ncas-repo serve --data <DATA_DIR> [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080]\n```\n\n- `--data` / `-d`：仓库数据目录（必填）。\n- `--addr` / `-a`：监听地址（默认 `127.0.0.1:8080`）。\n\n进程对一个数据目录拥有单进程所有权（不支持两个进程同时打开同一目录）。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 磁盘格式（format version 1，明确且稳定）\n\n```text\n<data-dir>/\n  VERSION                          # 内容固定为 \"cas-repo v1\\n\"\n  blocks/\n    <aa>/                          # 摘要第 1 字节，256 个分片子目录\n      <rest-62hex>                 # 不可变块：字节即块内容\n      <rest-62hex>.refs.json       # 引用边车: {\"version\":1,\"refs\":[\"<sha256>\",...]}\n      .<name>.tmp-<rand>           # 原子发布的暂存文件\n  roots/\n    <name>.json                    # 根指针: {\"hash\",\"version\",\"updated_at_ms\"}\n    .<name>.json.tmp-<rand>        # 根原子发布的暂存文件\n```\n\n格式规则：\n\n- 块文件路径由其摘要决定：`blocks/<前2位十六进制>/<后62位十六进制>`。\n- **不变性**：块字节一旦发布永不重写。再次 `put` 同摘要只做去重，并把新\n  声明的引用与旧边车取并集。\n- **引用边车**是独立 JSON 文件，随块一起原子更新；允许引用尚未上传的块\n  （前向引用），因此 GC 能显式报告\"缺失引用\"。\n- **根指针**是 `roots/<name>.json`，含目标块摘要、单调递增的 `version`\n  和 `updated_at_ms`。根名规则：`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`、长度 1–128、不得以点开头\n  （防止路径穿越和与暂存文件冲突）。\n- 每次写入都走 **`写同目录暂存文件 → fsync → rename 原子替换 → fsync 目录`**。\n  崩溃后可能残留 `.tmp-*` 文件；它们在**下次打开仓库时**统一回收（此刻无\n  并发写者，因为是单进程所有权）。GC 运行期间**不**删除暂存文件，以免误删\n  正在进行的上传。\n\n### 哈希的定位（重要）\n\nSHA-256 摘要**仅用于完整性校验**：\n\n- 上传时对实际字节求摘要；若客户端在信封里给了 `hash`，必须与实算值一致，\n  否则返回 `422 hash_mismatch`，块不落盘。\n- 读取时重新对磁盘字节求摘要，与地址不符返回 `409 corrupt_block`。\n- GC 标记每个可达块时也校验摘要，损坏块进入 `corrupt_blocks` 报告并被保留。\n\n摘要**不是**访问凭证/能力令牌；本服务没有鉴权层，仅绑定回环地址做本地验证。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 同步边界（concurrency model）\n\n单进程、多线程。一个 `Store` 对象拥有一个数据目录，内部边界如下：\n\n| 机制 | 保护对象 |\n|------|----------|\n| `upload: Mutex<()>` | 串行化块/边车发布，避免同摘要并发写互相踩踏暂存文件 |\n| `roots_lock: RwLock<()>` | **写者与 GC 互斥**：`put_block` 取读锁，`put_root`/`delete_root` 与 GC 取写锁；根切换、上传与 mark-sweep 永不交叠 |\n| `PinTable`（引用计数） | 保护\"正在读取/正在上传/GC 已标记\"的块不被清扫 |\n\n- **读块不加 `roots_lock`**：`get_block` 先 pin → 读 → 校验 → 读完 unpin。\n- **清扫在 pin 表锁内执行 unlink**：并发读/上传要么其 pin 已可见（跳过删除），\n  要么在删除完成后才 pin（此时观察到 not found 并可重建）。因此**可达块不\n  可能被误删**。\n- **根更新原子发布**：一次 temp+fsync+rename，读者只可能看到旧版本或新版本，\n  不存在半个根。发布失败时旧指针完好，新块成为孤儿（下次 GC 回收）。\n- 乐观并发（OCC）：`PUT /roots/{name}` 可带 `If-Match: <version>`，当前版本\n  不符返回 `409 version_conflict`（不存在的根版本记为 0）。\n\n这套设计把\"引用在标记中途被加入\"\"根在清扫中途切换\"两个窗口，通过写者/GC\n互斥从根上关闭；把\"读到一半被删\"通过 pin 在锁内删除关闭。\n\n---\n\n## 4. HTTP API\n\n所有连接走真实 TCP（HTTP/1.1、keep-alive、thread-per-connection），仅用于\n验证，不是生产级 Web 服务器（无 TLS、无鉴权）。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|------|------|------|\n| GET  | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| POST | `/blocks` | 上传块（原始字节，或 JSON 信封） |\n| GET  | `/blocks/{hash}` | 取原始字节（响应头回带 `X-Content-Sha256`，并重新校验） |\n| GET  | `/blocks/{hash}/info` | 块是否存在 + 引用列表 |\n| PUT  | `/roots/{name}` | 原子发布/更新根；可选 `If-Match: version` |\n| GET  | `/roots` | 列出全部根 |\n| GET  | `/roots/{name}` | 读取单个根 |\n| DELETE | `/roots/{name}` | 删除根（块不动，变为待回收） |\n| POST | `/gc` | 执行 mark-sweep，返回报告 |\n| GET  | `/stats` | 根数量、块数量、块字节数 |\n\n### 上传格式\n\n**原始字节**（`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`）：body 即块内容。\n可用请求头 `X-Content-Sha256: <hex>` 声明期望摘要（不符则拒绝）。\n\n**JSON 信封**（`Content-Type: application/json`）：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"data_b64\": \"<标准 base64 编码的块字节>\",\n  \"hash\":     \"<可选，客户端期望的 sha256 hex>\",\n  \"refs\":     [\"<可选，被引用块的 sha256 hex>\", \"...\"]\n}\n```\n\n### 发布根\n\nbody 可以是 JSON `{\"hash\":\"<hex>\"}`，也可以直接放裸摘要字符串。\n目标块必须已存在，否则 `404 not_found`。\n\n### GC 报告\n\n```json\n{\n  \"roots_scanned\": 2,\n  \"blocks_before\": 4,\n  \"blocks_live\": 4,\n  \"blocks_removed\": 1,\n  \"bytes_removed\": 34,\n  \"removed\": [\"<hex>\", \"...\"],\n  \"missing_references\": [ { \"parent\": \"<hex 或 null>\", \"missing\": \"<hex>\" } ],\n  \"corrupt_blocks\": [\"<hex>\"],\n  \"warnings\": []\n}\n```\n\n- 从所有根出发沿 `refs` 做可达性遍历；只清扫**不可达且未被 pin** 的块。\n- `missing_references`：父块（`parent=null` 表示根目标本身缺失）引用了磁盘上\n  不存在的摘要。父块本身可达时**保留**，只报告。\n- `corrupt_blocks`：可达但字节与地址摘要不符。保留并报告，绝不静默删除。\n\n完整可复制的请求样例见 [`examples/requests.http`](examples/requests.http)\n和可直接运行的 [`scripts/demo.sh`](scripts/demo.sh)。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 可注入 I/O 层与故障模拟\n\n所有磁盘访问都经过 `vfs::Vfs` trait（`src/vfs.rs`）：\n\n- `StdVfs`：`std::fs` 的薄封装，真实服务器使用。\n- `FaultyVfs`：包一层，在具名**调用点（site）**上注入故障。故障规则可在\n  运行时装填（`FaultMap::arm / fail_once / clear`），跨线程共享。\n\n故障动作（`FaultAction`）：\n\n- `Fail`：该调用直接返回注入的 `io::Error`，什么都不做。\n- `CorruptByte { offset, xor }`：写暂存文件前把指定字节异或，制造磁盘损坏。\n- `SucceedThenFail`：操作实际成功但仍返回错误（\"写成功却报错\"）。\n\n关键注入点：`rename_root`（根发布 rename 前崩溃）、`rename_block`、\n`rename_block_tmp`、`remove_block`、`read_block`、`exists_block` 等。\n\n示例（Rust，见 `tests/store_tests.rs`）：\n\n```rust\nlet faults = FaultMap::new();\nlet vfs = FaultyVfs::new(Box::new(StdVfs::new()), faults.clone());\nlet store = DynStore::open_boxed(dir, Box::new(vfs))?;\n\nlet a = store.put_block(b\"v1\", None, &[])?.hash;\nstore.put_root(\"main\", a, None)?;\nlet b = store.put_block(b\"v2\", None, &[])?.hash;\n\nfaults.fail_once(\"rename_root\");           // 根发布 rename 时\"崩溃\"\nassert!(store.put_root(\"main\", b, None).is_err());\nassert_eq!(store.get_root(\"main\")?.hash, a);   // 旧根完好\nassert!(store.block_exists(&b)?);              // 新块成为孤儿\nlet report = store.gc()?;                      // 孤儿被回收，可达块不动\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. 自动化测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test              # 全部\ncargo test --release    # 优化构建下再跑一遍\ncargo clippy --all-targets\n```\n\n测试组成：\n\n- `src/hash.rs`：SHA-256 NIST 向量（含一百万个 {"parentUuid":"37ea9746-c5e2-4ea4-af8e-7306eabebd98","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"b6983ca5-1408-4877-96aa-3a7731969248","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_6cx2w3vwnrge44nvju28mogc","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a/README.md (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"08cb7c23-7256-47f7-bd02-98db55dc6c7a","timestamp":"2026-09-23T03:25:06.387Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp5/a/README.md","content":"# cas-repo — 内容寻址块仓库（纯后端）\n\n一个用 Rust 实现的、**文件支持（file-backed）**的内容寻址存储库，带一个本地\nHTTP 验证入口。块按其内容的 SHA-256 摘要寻址、不可变；支持具名根（named\nroots）、同内容去重、根更新原子发布、标记清扫（mark-sweep）垃圾回收，并在\n读取/标记时用哈希做**完整性校验**。\n\n整个项目**零第三方依赖**：SHA-256、JSON、HTTP/1.1 服务器全部手写，可离线\n构建与审计。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\n\n# 启动（数据目录会自动初始化）\n./target/release/cas-repo serve --data ./data --addr 127.0.0.1:8080\n```\n\n只支持一个子命令：\n\n```text\ncas-repo serve --data <DATA_DIR> [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080]\n```\n\n- `--data` / `-d`：仓库数据目录（必填）。\n- `--addr` / `-a`：监听地址（默认 `127.0.0.1:8080`）。\n\n进程对一个数据目录拥有单进程所有权（不支持两个进程同时打开同一目录）。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 磁盘格式（format version 1，明确且稳定）\n\n```text\n<data-dir>/\n  VERSION                          # 内容固定为 \"cas-repo v1\\n\"\n  blocks/\n    <aa>/                          # 摘要第 1 字节，256 个分片子目录\n      <rest-62hex>                 # 不可变块：字节即块内容\n      <rest-62hex>.refs.json       # 引用边车: {\"version\":1,\"refs\":[\"<sha256>\",...]}\n      .<name>.tmp-<rand>           # 原子发布的暂存文件\n  roots/\n    <name>.json                    # 根指针: {\"hash\",\"version\",\"updated_at_ms\"}\n    .<name>.json.tmp-<rand>        # 根原子发布的暂存文件\n```\n\n格式规则：\n\n- 块文件路径由其摘要决定：`blocks/<前2位十六进制>/<后62位十六进制>`。\n- **不变性**：块字节一旦发布永不重写。再次 `put` 同摘要只做去重，并把新\n  声明的引用与旧边车取并集。\n- **引用边车**是独立 JSON 文件，随块一起原子更新；允许引用尚未上传的块\n  （前向引用），因此 GC 能显式报告\"缺失引用\"。\n- **根指针**是 `roots/<name>.json`，含目标块摘要、单调递增的 `version`\n  和 `updated_at_ms`。根名规则：`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`、长度 1–128、不得以点开头\n  （防止路径穿越和与暂存文件冲突）。\n- 每次写入都走 **`写同目录暂存文件 → fsync → rename 原子替换 → fsync 目录`**。\n  崩溃后可能残留 `.tmp-*` 文件；它们在**下次打开仓库时**统一回收（此刻无\n  并发写者，因为是单进程所有权）。GC 运行期间**不**删除暂存文件，以免误删\n  正在进行的上传。\n\n### 哈希的定位（重要）\n\nSHA-256 摘要**仅用于完整性校验**：\n\n- 上传时对实际字节求摘要；若客户端在信封里给了 `hash`，必须与实算值一致，\n  否则返回 `422 hash_mismatch`，块不落盘。\n- 读取时重新对磁盘字节求摘要，与地址不符返回 `409 corrupt_block`。\n- GC 标记每个可达块时也校验摘要，损坏块进入 `corrupt_blocks` 报告并被保留。\n\n摘要**不是**访问凭证/能力令牌；本服务没有鉴权层，仅绑定回环地址做本地验证。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 同步边界（concurrency model）\n\n单进程、多线程。一个 `Store` 对象拥有一个数据目录，内部边界如下：\n\n| 机制 | 保护对象 |\n|------|----------|\n| `upload: Mutex<()>` | 串行化块/边车发布，避免同摘要并发写互相踩踏暂存文件 |\n| `roots_lock: RwLock<()>` | **写者与 GC 互斥**：`put_block` 取读锁，`put_root`/`delete_root` 与 GC 取写锁；根切换、上传与 mark-sweep 永不交叠 |\n| `PinTable`（引用计数） | 保护\"正在读取/正在上传/GC 已标记\"的块不被清扫 |\n\n- **读块不加 `roots_lock`**：`get_block` 先 pin → 读 → 校验 → 读完 unpin。\n- **清扫在 pin 表锁内执行 unlink**：并发读/上传要么其 pin 已可见（跳过删除），\n  要么在删除完成后才 pin（此时观察到 not found 并可重建）。因此**可达块不\n  可能被误删**。\n- **根更新原子发布**：一次 temp+fsync+rename，读者只可能看到旧版本或新版本，\n  不存在半个根。发布失败时旧指针完好，新块成为孤儿（下次 GC 回收）。\n- 乐观并发（OCC）：`PUT /roots/{name}` 可带 `If-Match: <version>`，当前版本\n  不符返回 `409 version_conflict`（不存在的根版本记为 0）。\n\n这套设计把\"引用在标记中途被加入\"\"根在清扫中途切换\"两个窗口，通过写者/GC\n互斥从根上关闭；把\"读到一半被删\"通过 pin 在锁内删除关闭。\n\n---\n\n## 4. HTTP API\n\n所有连接走真实 TCP（HTTP/1.1、keep-alive、thread-per-connection），仅用于\n验证，不是生产级 Web 服务器（无 TLS、无鉴权）。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|------|------|------|\n| GET  | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| POST | `/blocks` | 上传块（原始字节，或 JSON 信封） |\n| GET  | `/blocks/{hash}` | 取原始字节（响应头回带 `X-Content-Sha256`，并重新校验） |\n| GET  | `/blocks/{hash}/info` | 块是否存在 + 引用列表 |\n| PUT  | `/roots/{name}` | 原子发布/更新根；可选 `If-Match: version` |\n| GET  | `/roots` | 列出全部根 |\n| GET  | `/roots/{name}` | 读取单个根 |\n| DELETE | `/roots/{name}` | 删除根（块不动，变为待回收） |\n| POST | `/gc` | 执行 mark-sweep，返回报告 |\n| GET  | `/stats` | 根数量、块数量、块字节数 |\n\n### 上传格式\n\n**原始字节**（`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`）：body 即块内容。\n可用请求头 `X-Content-Sha256: <hex>` 声明期望摘要（不符则拒绝）。\n\n**JSON 信封**（`Content-Type: application/json`）：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"data_b64\": \"<标准 base64 编码的块字节>\",\n  \"hash\":     \"<可选，客户端期望的 sha256 hex>\",\n  \"refs\":     [\"<可选，被引用块的 sha256 hex>\", \"...\"]\n}\n```\n\n### 发布根\n\nbody 可以是 JSON `{\"hash\":\"<hex>\"}`，也可以直接放裸摘要字符串。\n目标块必须已存在，否则 `404 not_found`。\n\n### GC 报告\n\n```json\n{\n  \"roots_scanned\": 2,\n  \"blocks_before\": 4,\n  \"blocks_live\": 4,\n  \"blocks_removed\": 1,\n  \"bytes_removed\": 34,\n  \"removed\": [\"<hex>\", \"...\"],\n  \"missing_references\": [ { \"parent\": \"<hex 或 null>\", \"missing\": \"<hex>\" } ],\n  \"corrupt_blocks\": [\"<hex>\"],\n  \"warnings\": []\n}\n```\n\n- 从所有根出发沿 `refs` 做可达性遍历；只清扫**不可达且未被 pin** 的块。\n- `missing_references`：父块（`parent=null` 表示根目标本身缺失）引用了磁盘上\n  不存在的摘要。父块本身可达时**保留**，只报告。\n- `corrupt_blocks`：可达但字节与地址摘要不符。保留并报告，绝不静默删除。\n\n完整可复制的请求样例见 [`examples/requests.http`](examples/requests.http)\n和可直接运行的 [`scripts/demo.sh`](scripts/demo.sh)。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 可注入 I/O 层与故障模拟\n\n所有磁盘访问都经过 `vfs::Vfs` trait（`src/vfs.rs`）：\n\n- `StdVfs`：`std::fs` 的薄封装，真实服务器使用。\n- `FaultyVfs`：包一层，在具名**调用点（site）**上注入故障。故障规则可在\n  运行时装填（`FaultMap::arm / fail_once / clear`），跨线程共享。\n\n故障动作（`FaultAction`）：\n\n- `Fail`：该调用直接返回注入的 `io::Error`，什么都不做。\n- `CorruptByte { offset, xor }`：写暂存文件前把指定字节异或，制造磁盘损坏。\n- `SucceedThenFail`：操作实际成功但仍返回错误（\"写成功却报错\"）。\n\n关键注入点：`rename_root`（根发布 rename 前崩溃）、`rename_block`、\n`rename_block_tmp`、`remove_block`、`read_block`、`exists_block` 等。\n\n示例（Rust，见 `tests/store_tests.rs`）：\n\n```rust\nlet faults = FaultMap::new();\nlet vfs = FaultyVfs::new(Box::new(StdVfs::new()), faults.clone());\nlet store = DynStore::open_boxed(dir, Box::new(vfs))?;\n\nlet a = store.put_block(b\"v1\", None, &[])?.hash;\nstore.put_root(\"main\", a, None)?;\nlet b = store.put_block(b\"v2\", None, &[])?.hash;\n\nfaults.fail_once(\"rename_root\");           // 根发布 rename 时\"崩溃\"\nassert!(store.put_root(\"main\", b, None).is_err());\nassert_eq!(store.get_root(\"main\")?.hash, a);   // 旧根完好\nassert!(store.block_exists(&b)?);              // 新块成为孤儿\nlet report = store.gc()?;                      // 孤儿被回收，可达块不动\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. 自动化测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test              # 全部\ncargo test --release    # 优化构建下再跑一遍\ncargo clippy --all-targets\n```\n\n测试组成：\n\n- `src/hash.rs`：SHA-256 NIST 向量（含一百万个 'a'）、跨块边界流式一致性。\n- `src/json.rs`：往返、Unicode 转义、尾随垃圾拒绝。\n- `tests/store_tests.rs`（19 个）：\n  - 去重、声明哈希校验、根发布与 OCC、非法根名；\n  - **孤儿块回收 / 可达块保留**；\n  - **缺失引用**（父块引用幽灵块、根目标缺失）；\n  - **pin 保护**、读与 GC 并发、根切换与 GC 竞态、上传与 GC 竞态；\n  - **同块 16 线程并发上传**（恰好一个非去重）、8×10 个不同块并发上传；\n  - 故障注入：**根切换中断**（旧根保留、新块孤儿、残留暂存文件重开清理）、\n    块写失败不落盘、损坏块读取拒绝/GC 报告保留、GC 删除 I/O 失败中止。\n  - 重开持久化、格式版本不匹配拒绝。\n- `tests/http_tests.rs`（8 个）：真实 TCP 端到端，覆盖健康检查、原始/JSON\n  上传、去重、下载校验、哈希不符 422、根生命周期与 OCC、GC 端点、\n  **12 个 HTTP 客户端并发上传同块**、404。\n\n---\n\n## 7. 实际运行记录（本次交付环境）\n\n环境：Linux 6.8.0，`rustc 1.981` / `cargo 1.98.1`（实际为 1.98.1）。\n\n### 7.1 单元/集成测试\n\n```text\n$ cargo test\nrunning 6 tests   ... src/lib.rs        6 passed; 0 failed\nrunning 8 tests   ... tests/http_tests.rs   8 passed; 0 failed\nrunning 19 --all-targets` 无\n警告。\n\n### 7.2 真实二进制端到端\n\n`./scripts/demo.sh`（退出码 0）验证：两块上传 → 重复上传 `deduplicated:true`\n→ 带引用的 manifest 上传 → 块 info → 原子发布根 `main` → 下载回读 →\n哈希不符被 `422` 拒绝 → 造孤儿块后 `POST /gc` 回收\n（`blocks_removed:1`）→ 造缺失引用，GC 在 `missing_references` 中报告且\n保留父块 → **8 个并发客户端上传同块**，返回同一个摘要且恰有一个\n`deduplicated:false` → 最终 `stats {blocks:5, roots:2}`。\n\n另手工验证（输出见提交时的会话记录）：\n\n- 直接篡改磁盘块首字节后
